description: Detects injected anomalies in a synthetic seasonal time series via seasonal decomposition with MAD thresholding, compared to a moving-average baseline, reporting precision, recall, and F1 on a chronological test split.
method: Algorithm: fit linear trend (np.polyfit) and sinusoidal seasonal (FFT peak frequency + least-squares on sin/cos basis) on the first 75% of the series; flag test points where |residual| > 3 * 1.4826 * MAD of train residuals. Baseline: centered 7-point moving average; flag test points where |deviation from MA| > 3 * std of train deviations. Both thresholds use train-only statistics to prevent leakage. Metrics: precision, recall, F1 (higher is better, range [0,1]) computed on the last 25% of points only.
category: Advanced data analysis and machine learning: time series or small image arrays
